evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 3.006 Torr and exhaust oxygen 4.7 ppm.
Pressure increased to 3.110 Torr and oxygen to 11.8 ppm during unchanged growth setpoints.

Pressure increased further to 3.196 Torr and oxygen to 19.0 ppm while temperature remained at 750.4 C, argon at 99.8 sccm, and heater power at 44.4%; this joint upward trend is inconsistent with the preceding stable growth conditions.

args.missing_evidence: A seal-integrity/leak check and exhaust-path check are needed to distinguish suspected air ingress from other pressure/oxygen faults; sample characterization is not yet available.
